roles.title: Backend Engineer
roles.blurb: Great hiring products feel simple on the surface. That simplicity is earned in the backend.

roles.title: AI/ML Engineer
roles.blurb: Practical AI systems that make hiring decisions clearer, more structured, and easier to trust.

roles.title: Software Intern
roles.blurb: This is not a shadowing internship. You will do real work, ship real output, and learn in context.

roles.title: Talent Advisor
roles.blurb: The resume tells you what someone did. It rarely tells you what they can do. We are building the team that knows the difference.

roles.title: Senior Delivery Partner
roles.blurb: Activity is easy to measure. Outcomes are harder. We are accountable for who joins, not for how many profiles were shared.

roles.title: Talent Associate
roles.blurb: Every expert was once a beginner who refused to stay one. You will not file resumes. You will learn to read people.

roles.title: Growth Intern
roles.blurb: Not every conversation closes a deal. The best ones open a door. That is the whole job, and it matters.
